description: Land Acquisition - Mapakadawewa and Beeriulpatha, 41 and 01 and 19 Allotments in Paragammana, 31 and 11 Allotments in Poojanagaraya 11 and 20 and 10 allotments in Elewela, Mapakadawewa, Beeriulpatha, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division,  Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land lots being acquired by the government for public purposes.
